page_title: ALA 0-1 RMA | Alaves v Real Madrid 21/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Problems for Carlo Ancelotti as Rodrygo is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) replaces him.
90+5' Looks like Rodrygo (Real Madrid) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90+2' 0 - 1 The resulting corner is whipped in by Toni Kroos and Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) is left unmarked to plant a precise header into the top left corner. The score is 0:1.
90+2' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is about to take a corner kick.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
89' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) rises highest from the corner and heads at goal, but his effort towards the bottom right corner is saved by Kepa Arrizabalaga.
89' Alaves earn a corner.

89' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Luis Rioja (Alaves) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in. The ball goes behind for a corner. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
84' It must be a yellow card. It is. Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) receives the caution after an awful tackle.

84' Antonio Sivera makes a brilliant save! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper!
83' Isidro Diaz de Mera shows a yellow card to Javi Lopez (Alaves) for his blatant foul.
80' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Antonio Sivera intercepts the ball.
80' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
78' Samu Omorodion goes off the pitch and Kike Garcia (Alaves) comes on.
78' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) replaces Andoni Gorosabel.
78' Ianis Hagi (Alaves) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
76' We are about to witness a substitution. Joselu (Real Madrid) is replacing Brahim Diaz.

75' The opposition can't get near Rodrygo (Real Madrid), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
75' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Abderrahmane Rebbach as he is replaced by Alex Sola (Alaves).

71' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
70' The ratio of the ball possession is 38:62.
68' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
65' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
63' A pass from Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is intercepted by Antonio Sivera and the move breaks down.
62' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Samu Omorodion (Alaves), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
60' Luis Garcia Plaza decides to make a substitution. Ruben Duarte will be replaced by Javi Lopez (Alaves).
59' It is time for a substitution. Ianis Hagi (Alaves) is on for Jon Guridi.
56' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
55' Luka Modric will be replaced by Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid).
54' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

53' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid), but referee Isidro Diaz de Mera must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
53' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
52' Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) takes out his opponent with a horrific tackle and is relieved when the referee only shows him a yellow card.
51' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Alaves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' The resulting set piece from Real Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
47' Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
47' The attendance for today's match is 19275.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) collects a pass and has an effort from distance which is blocked.
45+1' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Ruben Duarte (Alaves) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz de Mera didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
41' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
41' Real Madrid take a quick free kick and immediately restart play.
39' Carlo Ancelotti is stunned as referee Isidro Diaz de Mera shows him a yellow card. What was that for?

38' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the left side of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!

37' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is behind the touchline and Alaves will take a throw-in.
36' Luis Rioja (Alaves) sends a cross into the box, but Kepa Arrizabalaga comes off his line to gather the ball.
34' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) arrives first to a high rebound and directs a header low towards the middle of the target. The goalkeeper is alert and comfortably denies him.
32' Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Isidro Diaz de Mera has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Alaves have a free kick.
29' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is flagged for offside.
28' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
25' Samu Omorodion (Alaves) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
23' Alaves work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

21' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
20' Kepa Arrizabalaga makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Rafa Marin (Alaves) after a cross from the side.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Alaves comes to nothing.
18' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
18' Isidro Diaz de Mera blows his whistle for a foul after Luis Rioja (Alaves) hacks down one of his opponents. Real Madrid win a free kick.
17' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
16' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
11' Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Isidro Diaz de Mera interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
8' Luis Rioja (Alaves) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Luis Rioja (Alaves) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
7' Andoni Gorosabel (Alaves) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
5' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
2' A pass into the box finds Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom right corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Antonio Sivera denies him.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Madrid will have the kick-off.
Isidro Diaz de Mera got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
